title: Hearty Crispy Italian Grape Tomatoes Pasta
description: A comforting Italian dish featuring crispy grape tomatoes and pasta, pressure-cooked to perfection, with a sour and satisfying taste, kosher-friendly.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions until al dente.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and add the halved grape tomatoes.
Cook the grape tomatoes for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until they start to release their juices and become tender.
Add the minced garlic, red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the grated parmesan cheese and cook until melted and well combined.
Add the cooked pasta to the skillet, tossing to combine with the tomato mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta and toss to coat.
Season with additional salt and black pepper if needed.
Garnish with chopped fresh basil and serve immediately.
For an extra crispy top, place the pasta under the broiler for 2-3 minutes, watching carefully to avoid burning.
